created_at.description: The project creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

organization_id.description: The Appwrite organization ID. Defaults to the provider-level organization_id.

region.description: The region where the project is hosted. Defaults to the server's configured region.

team_id.description: The ID of the team that owns the project.

updated_at.description: The project last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

block.description: Manages an Appwrite project within an organization.

allowed_file_extensions.description: List of allowed file extensions. An empty list allows all extensions.

antivirus.description: Whether virus scanning is enabled. Defaults to true.

compression.description: Compression algorithm: none, gzip, or zstd. Defaults to none.

created_at.description: The bucket creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

enabled.description: Whether the bucket is enabled. Defaults to true.

encryption.description: Whether bucket encryption is enabled. Defaults to true.

file_security.description: Whether file-level security is enabled. When enabled, users can access files for which they have been granted permissions. Defaults to false.

id.description: The bucket ID. Must be unique within the project.

project_id.description: The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.

transformations.description: Whether image transformations are enabled. Defaults to false.

updated_at.description: The bucket last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
